name: Northside Baltimore [ALPHA]
description:
Start your shift in Baltimore. Create a resident, pick up the phone and find work on the docks, behind a barber chair or on emergency calls. Spend your pay on a new outfit, fill up the car and meet friends back at your rowhouse.

Walk the Inner Harbor to board USS Constellation, visit Seven Foot Knoll Lighthouse and see the Douglass and Marshall mural inside the Pier 8 Maritime Gallery. Police, arrests, bail and neighborhood rivalries are part of the roleplay.

Alpha release. Open GUIDE for controls and directions.
